interface.title: SIEVE — Mechanistic Variant Interpretation Platform (backend: Digital Patient Twin v0.1)
interface.field: Clinical genomics / structural bioinformatics (missense variant pathogenicity)
interface.stage_of_work: Interpretation and reporting: triaging single missense variants and benchmarking the classifier against ClinVar
interface.what_it_is_for: Enter a gene, a missense change and a UniProt accession, and get an AlphaFold structure view, a pLDDT confidence profile, contact-network disruption metrics, conservation, a pathogenicity tier with its rationale, exportable reports and a per-gene ClinVar validation benchmark.

data.note: The dashboard is served at / ; /dashboard and /dashboard/ return {"detail":"Not Found"} (screens/001.webp), even though the README points to /dashboard. It opens prefilled with VCP · R155H · P55072 and runs the full pipeline automatically. I also ran VCP R191Q, LMNA R482W (P02545), CFTR G551D and CFTR S700A (P13569), all on the server's cached or fetched data. Validation used 50 cached ClinVar variants for each gene. No files were uploaded.

tree.general: Decide how likely a single amino-acid change is to cause disease, and document the evidence
tree.specific: Classify a missense variant into SIEVE's 1–5 pathogenicity tiers from AlphaFold structure and confidence, contact-graph disruption and 3D-neighbourhood conservation evidence, with the ClinVar record shown alongside the call (ClinVar is not an input to the tier; it is used to benchmark the classifier), then export a clinical report

features.name: 3D structure viewer with mutation focus, representation and colour-scheme switching
features.general: Show a 3D molecular model, highlight and fly to one position of interest, and switch how the model is drawn and coloured (by confidence, secondary structure, hydrophobicity, sequence position, chain); hover to identify atoms
features.specific: NGL-style AlphaFold viewer: the mutated residue is drawn as red ball-and-stick with a label (ARG155). Focus Mutation animates the camera to it. Cartoon/Surface/Ball&Stick/Spacefill buttons and a Color scheme dropdown (Confidence = pLDDT B-factor, Secondary Structure, Chain, Hydrophobicity, Sequence Position). Wheel zooms, drag rotates, and hovering shows an atom tooltip. The canvas sometimes renders black while the page is part-scrolled, and Surface/Spacefill are slow to draw.
steps: run an analysis so the structure loads with the mutated residue labelled
zoom out with the wheel and rotate by dragging
press Focus Mutation to fly back to the residue
switch representation (Cartoon / Surface / Ball & Stick / Spacefill)
choose a colour scheme (Confidence, Secondary Structure, Hydrophobicity, …)
hover atoms to read the residue/atom ID
serves_tasks: Find the changed position on the 3D model and judge how trustworthy the local model is
Show the model in other representations and colourings

features.name: Per-position confidence profile with highlighted site
features.general: Summarise a per-position quality score (mean, min, max, fraction below a threshold) and plot it along the sequence, colour-banded by quality, with the position of interest marked; hover any point to read its value
features.specific: Confidence Profile: stat tiles (Mean pLDDT, Min, Max, % < 70) and a pLDDT-versus-residue line chart coloured by AlphaFold band, with a red marker at the mutation. The tooltip gives residue number, pLDDT and the mutation label. Clicking a point does not drive the 3D viewer.
steps: read the summary tiles (mean / min / max / % < 70)
find the red marker for the mutated residue on the line
hover the marker or any residue to read its pLDDT
compare the site against disordered (red) stretches to decide whether structural evidence applies
serves_tasks: Read the per-position confidence profile and where the change sits on it
Analyse a change in a low-confidence (disordered) region to see the alternative route

features.name: Live-recompute input form with pipeline stepper and status bar
features.general: Three identifier fields that re-run the analysis as you edit them, with a stage-by-stage progress list and a status line that reports running, done or a parse error
features.specific: Gene Symbol / Variant / UniProt Accession fields. Editing a field triggers 'Waiting…' then 'Recomputing variant…' or 'Running full pipeline'; Analyze Variant forces a run. The header chip echoes GENE · VARIANT · UNIPROT. The stepper (Data Foundation, Confidence Audit, Graph Analysis, Stability ΔΔG, Clinical Report) turns amber, green or red; red shows with errors like 'Cannot parse mutation ABC'. A wrong reference residue (e.g. Q482W where 482 is Arg) is accepted silently.
steps: edit gene / variant / accession (or press Analyze Variant)
watch the status bar and stepper advance through the stages
read 'Analysis complete' or an error message
fix the input and rerun
serves_tasks: Submit a variant and run the full analysis
Analyse a second change in the same protein
Analyse a variant in a different protein
Analyse a well-characterised disease variant in another protein
Quality check: see how the analysis treats malformed or inconsistent input

features.name: Tiered classification card with evidence sub-panels
features.general: Present a final ordinal category with label and rationale, next to an external-database record for the same change and the secondary evidence (stability, model confidence, literature)
features.specific: Clinical Summary: tier number (1–5), label (e.g. 'Uncertain significance — destabilising signal', 'Likely pathogenic — functional'), rationale (e.g. 'Graph tier MODERATE; ΔΔG not calculated'), ClinVar card (significance, HGVS, conditions) and Stability & Literature card (ΔΔG, pLDDT, concordant/discordant papers). The ClinVar card can show a different substitution at the same residue (R155S for R155H), and low pLDDT can be labelled 'High Structural Fidelity'.
steps: run an analysis
read the tier and rationale
check that the ClinVar record's HGVS matches the variant, then read its conditions
check the stability, confidence and literature lines
serves_tasks: Read the final category, its rationale and the external database record
Analyse a change in a low-confidence (disordered) region to see the alternative route

features.name: Network-disruption, routing and conservation metrics panel
features.general: Report which confidence track a position was routed to, how central it is in a contact graph (percentile ranks), what removing its contacts does to the graph (edges lost, path-length change, components split, clustering), and a 3D-neighbourhood conservation score, with a one-line evidence note on the substitution
features.specific: Variant Assessment: graph-tier badge (MODERATE) with routing text, Layer 2 C3D 3D-neighbourhood score and environment ('Conserved shell'), pLDDT, betweenness pct, degree pct, contacts broken, Δ avg path length, components split, clustering coeff., and a note such as '[CHEM_OVERRIDE] Conservative substitution in dense hub… top-10% betweenness hub'. The pLDDT and C3D on this card can be carried over from the previous analysis.
steps: run an analysis
read the graph-tier badge and routing
read centrality percentiles and the disruption metrics
read the C3D conservation score when the gene has conservation data
compare across variants by re-running
serves_tasks: Check which confidence track the site was routed to before trusting structure-based evidence
Check how central the position is in the residue contact network, how much the change disrupts it, and what kind of chemical substitution it is
Check how conserved the change's 3D neighbourhood is

features.name: Benchmark against labelled cases (confusion matrix plus summary statistics)
features.general: Score a set of known-label cases with the classifier and show MCC, accuracy, sensitivity, specificity and a 2×2 confusion matrix with the dataset description
features.specific: Validation Suite: Run Validation scores 50 cached ClinVar variants for the current gene through Layer 0 and shows MCC / Accuracy / Sensitivity / Specificity tiles, a Pred. Pathogenic/Benign × Actual Pathogenic/Benign matrix (TP/FN/FP/TN), and a caption 'GENE · 50 ClinVar variants · source: clinvar'. Results are not cleared when the gene changes, and a run can take several minutes.
steps: set the gene in the analysis form
press Run Validation
wait for 'Validation complete — 50 variants'
read the metrics tiles and confusion matrix
switch gene and repeat to compare
serves_tasks: Measure agreement with known labels: confusion matrix, MCC, sensitivity, specificity

features.name: Multi-format report export
features.general: Export the current result as structured JSON, a Markdown narrative report with caveats and audit trail, and a printable HTML brief
features.specific: Export JSON → GENE_MUT_report.json (variant, classification, layer0_graph, layer1_ddg, literature, clinvar, domain_context, caveats). Export Markdown → GENE_MUT_report.md (8 sections incl. evidence audit trail). Clinical Brief (PDF) → /api/report/GENE/MUT/brief HTML page with a 'Print / Save as PDF' link.
steps: finish an analysis
press Export JSON and/or Export Markdown
press Clinical Brief (PDF) to open the printable brief
print or save it as PDF from the brief page
serves_tasks: Export the result as a machine-readable file, a text report and a printable brief

Observed problems worth flagging (also attached as caveats on the affected tasks). (1) The Variant Assessment card's 'pLDDT confidence' and C3D score are carried over from the previous analysis: LMNA R482W showed 87.8 and C3D 0.909 from VCP R191Q, while the chart, Clinical Summary and JSON give 95.5 and c_3d null (screens/040, 041; LMNA JSON). CFTR G551D and S700A then showed 95.5 carried over from LMNA. (2) The ClinVar card matches a different substitution at the same residue: R155H showed p.Arg155Ser, and G551D showed p.Gly551Val. (3) The Clinical Summary labels a pLDDT of 26.1 'High Structural Fidelity' for a disordered residue (screens/063). (4) The reference amino acid is not checked: Q482W was accepted although residue 482 is Arg (screens/046), and K155H was accepted in the replay. (5) The Validation Suite results are not cleared when the gene changes. (6) The 3D canvas sometimes renders black while the page is part-scrolled (screens/055–060).
